Description
Team DP NOVA is a 5-member engineering team from Velalar College of Engineering and Technology (VCET), Erode. We are participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge under the track "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data." Our project, AgriShift, processes NASA soil moisture, temperature, and precipitation data to deliver actionable micro-climate advisory for local farmers. Our team is fully formed and currently locking in registration.
